root_cause.text: Missing validation of the port range encoding in the checkentry function of xt_multiport, allowing malformed rules where a range start is placed at the last slot or adjacent to another range start, leading to out-of-bounds array access in ports_match_v1().
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds multiport_valid_ranges() which checks that each range start has a following element and that the following element is not itself a range start (i.e., pflags[i] and pflags[i+1] are validated). The commit message explicitly states: "The checkentry path currently validates protocol, flags and count, but it does not validate the range encoding itself. As a result, malformed rules can mark the last slot as a range start or place two range starts back to back, leaving ports_match_v1() to step past the last valid ports[] element while interpreting the rule."
